stemMd: A circular sector has radius 6 and central angle 120 degrees. What is its area?
explanationMd: The sector occupies one third of a full circle. Multiply $\pi6^2$ by $120/360$ to obtain $12\pi$.

distractorRationale.b: Calculates the arc length rather than area.
distractorRationale.d: Treats the angle as a semicircle.
distractorRationale.c: Uses the area of the entire circle.
